correctness.rationale: At the quotient h=2/Lambda_n, Taylor integral and K^2<=Lambda K give V(Fz)-V(z)<=0, strictly <0 whenever K sin z !=0 because a moving coordinate cannot have cos equal to -1 on a whole nontrivial interval. If 4 does not divide n, equal-sine coordinates subject to sum z=0 give finitely many nondegenerate critical points: the equal-multiplicity or cos(alpha)=0 degeneracies would force 4|n. Compactness plus vanishing drop and increments implies every orbit tends to one critical point; nonsink Hessian has an expanding multiplier, the local center-stable set is null, and analytic nonidentically-zero Jacobian determinant makes all its preimages null. For n=2 (mod 4), the alternating eigenmode has multiplier -1 at h=1/2, invariant scalar map u_next=u-2sin u=-u+u^3/3+O(u^5), giving k u_k^2 -> 3/2; strong-stable foliation tracks it exponentially, with exceptional leaf exponential. At h>1/2 multiplier crosses -1. Independent 20k-step scalar iteration gave 1.496875, and endpoint potential decrease for n=5,6 was independently checked. General local foliation and center-stable theorems are invoked, not independently formalized.
